result.instruction: Replace the `count_next` temporary and the enabled count branch’s all-ones comparison with an explicitly `WIDTH+1`-bit increment result. On enabled cycles, load its low `WIDTH` bits into `count` and use its carry-out for `overflow`; retain the existing reset, load priority, and disabled-cycle holds. Preserve the registered threshold flags and their one-cycle-old-count behavior, and keep all parameter and high-bit semantics unchanged. The candidate must pass the unchanged verification and routed metric gates, and improve the LUT objective to be promotable.
